name: nwflash-rom
description: VivoKsu ROM OTA 链接代理(Cloudflare Worker),上游 VOTA api.otau.cc.cd

scripts.predeploy: wrangler secret list --format json | node -e "let input='';process.stdin.on('data',chunk=>input+=chunk).on('end',()=>{const secrets=JSON.parse(input);if(!secrets.some(secret=>secret.name==='SESSION_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PKCS8')){console.error('Missing Cloudflare secret: SESSION_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PKCS8');process.exit(1)}})"
scripts.test:admin: npm run test:admin:unit && npm run test:admin:e2e
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --lib ES2022,WebWorker --types @cloudflare/workers-types --skipLibCheck src/index.ts src/security.ts src/trace-v2-contract.ts src/trace-v2-redaction.ts src/trace-v2-ingest.ts src/trace-v2-retention.ts && tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --lib ES2022,WebWorker --types @cloudflare/workers-types --skipLibCheck src/trace-v2-contract.ts web/src/trace-v2-query.ts && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/typecheck-api && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config web/wrangler.toml --outdir .wrangler/typecheck-web
